query:
SELECT pc.mes, pc.ano, pc.quantidadeVendida,
  (SELECT SUM(cs.totalGeral) FROM custo_setor cs WHERE cs.periodoCustoId = pc.id) as custoTotal
FROM periodo_custo pc
WHERE pc.mes IN (2,3,4) AND pc.ano = 2026
ORDER BY pc.mes;
